body:
Real, live CI failure on commit fc257c4 (the 16-card system commit):
Windows cross-compile linker error, "undefined reference to
on_ecowar_resolve_card_magnitude". Same exact recurring bug class this
CI step's own comments already document twice before (bloodflower_mod,
tree_passive_mod): this Windows cross-compile is a third, separate
build path from scripts/build.sh and scripts/build_arena.sh, and gets
missed whenever a new PARENA mod lands even when those two scripts are
correctly updated.

Fixed by adding -include card_effect_mod_host.h and
packages/simulation/card_effect_mod.c to the CI link command. Verified
with a real local mingw cross-compile against the exact
SDL2-devel-2.30.10-mingw package CI itself downloads (not just
assumed) -- produces a valid PE32+ Windows executable. Linux
scripts/build.sh still exits clean.

ECOWAR commit ed369bb. CI run 33110529612: both jobs green (build,
Tag & Release).

title: CI fixed: card_effect_mod.c wired into Windows cross-compile step
